results.query: Draw a labeled diagram of a plant cell showing all major organelles
results.full_prompt: Draw a labeled diagram of a plant cell showing all major organelles
results.clip_prompt: plant cell diagram, nucleus, mitochondria, chloroplast, endoplasmic reticulum, golgi apparatus, cell wall, vacuole, educational illustration, scientific cross-section, clean linework, white background, biology textbook style, no text labels
results.t5_prompt: A detailed scientific illustration of a plant cell in cross-section showing all major organelles with accurate spatial relationships and biological structures. The cell is displayed against a white background in a clear educational diagram style. The cell wall forms the rigid outer boundary composed of cellulose fibers. Just inside the cell wall is the cell membrane, a thin lipid bilayer controlling substance transport. The large central vacuole occupies most of the cell interior, containing cell sap for turgor pressure and nutrient storage, surrounded by a distinct tonoplast membrane. The cytoplasm fills the space between the vacuole and cell membrane, appearing as a gel-like substance. The nucleus is positioned centrally, bounded by a double nuclear envelope with nuclear pores, containing the nucleolus where ribosomal RNA is synthesized and a network of chromatin. Mitochondria appear as elongated or rounded organelles with outer and inner membranes, cristae visible inside for cellular respiration. Chloroplasts are large, oval-shaped organelles containing stacked thylakoids arranged in grana and a stroma matrix for photosynthesis, with their own double membrane envelope. The endoplasmic reticulum extends throughout the cytoplasm, with rough endoplasmic reticulum studded with ribosomes for protein synthesis, and smooth endoplasmic reticulum without ribosomes for lipid synthesis. The Golgi apparatus appears as stacked cisternae for protein modification and packaging. Ribosomes are visible as small particles on rough ER and free in cytoplasm. Plasmodesmata connect through the cell wall to adjacent cells. The drawing uses scientific accuracy with clear three-dimensional perspective showing all organelles in their proper locations and proportions.

results.query: Draw a detailed cross-section of a mitochondria showing cristae and matrix

results.t5_prompt: A detailed scientific cross-section illustration of a mitochondrion showing its complete internal structure. The outer mitochondrial membrane forms a smooth continuous boundary on the exterior. Just inside lies the inner mitochondrial membrane which is highly folded and convoluted, creating numerous cristae that extend deep into the interior space. These cristae are finger-like projections and shelf-like folds that dramatically increase the surface area for oxidative phosphorylation. The space between the outer and inner membranes is the intermembrane space, shown as a thin defined region. The central cavity is filled with the mitochondrial matrix, a gel-like substance containing enzymes, mitochondrial DNA, ribosomes, and metabolites involved in the citric acid cycle and other metabolic pathways. The cristae membranes are colored distinctly different from the matrix to show the separation of oxidative phosphorylation machinery from the metabolic reactions occurring in the matrix. Small round structures representing ribosomes are scattered throughout the matrix. The mitochondrial DNA appears as circular strands within the matrix. The illustration uses a white background, employs scientific accuracy with educational clarity, shows cross-sectional depth with shading and layering, includes no text labels or annotations, and presents the mitochondrion in the style of a detailed textbook biology diagram with precise anatomical rendering.

results.query: Draw a labeled diagram of a neuron showing axon, dendrites and myelin sheath
results.full_prompt: Draw a labeled diagram of a neuron showing axon, dendrites and myelin sheath
results.clip_prompt: neuron diagram, axon, dendrites, myelin sheath, scientific illustration, educational, clean linework, white background, biology textbook style, no text labels
results.t5_prompt: A detailed scientific illustration of a complete neuron showing all major anatomical structures on a white background in an educational diagram style. The neuron cell body or soma is positioned centrally, containing the large round nucleus with a darker nucleolus visible inside. Extending outward from the soma are multiple branching dendrites with smaller dendritic spines along their length, showing how they receive signals from other neurons. The single long axon projects from the axon hillock and extends downward, wrapped in a myelin sheath that appears as segments of white insulation separated by small gaps called nodes of Ranvier where the axon membrane is exposed. The myelin sheath is formed by oligodendrocytes that wrap around the axon in multiple layers, and these wrappings are shown as concentric rings in cross-section views. At the terminal end of the axon are the axon terminals forming synaptic knobs that connect to other neurons. The entire structure is rendered with realistic biological coloring showing the gray cell body, the myelin sheath in lighter tones contrasting against exposed axon segments, and fine detail of the branching dendritic tree. This is a clean scientific textbook illustration with anatomical accuracy suitable for neuroscience education.

The cornea is depicted as the clear dome-shaped anterior structure at the front. Behind it lies the aqueous humor filling the anterior chamber. The iris is shown as the colored muscular tissue surrounding the pupil, which appears as a dark central opening. The lens sits immediately behind the iris, depicted as a clear biconvex structure suspended by ciliary fibers. The vitreous humor fills the large posterior chamber as a translucent gel. The retina lines the inner posterior wall, shown as a layered tissue with the photoreceptor layer containing rods and cones closest to the back wall. The retinal pigment epithelium appears adjacent to the retina's outer surface. The choroid layer lies beneath the retina providing blood supply. The sclera forms the white outer fibrous coat of the eyeball. The optic nerve emerges from the back of the eye, depicted as a thick bundle of neural fibers. The fovea is shown as a slight depression on the retina at the posterior pole where vision is sharpest. All structures are rendered in anatomically accurate proportions with appropriate coloring: clear cornea and lens, red and orange tones for vascular tissues, white for sclera, pigmented retina, and the optic nerve in yellow and white. results.query: Draw a labeled diagram of a leaf showing blade, midrib, petiole and veins
results.full_prompt: Draw a labeled diagram of a leaf showing blade, midrib, petiole and veins

results.t5_prompt: An educational scientific diagram of a leaf structure showing all major anatomical components on a white background. The leaf blade forms the broad, flat photosynthetic surface with a smooth or slightly textured appearance. The midrib runs as a prominent central vein down the length of the blade, appearing as a slightly raised linear structure that provides structural support. The petiole extends from the base of the leaf blade as a slender stalk that connects the leaf to the stem, often appearing slightly cylindrical or flattened. Secondary veins branch laterally from the midrib in a pinnate or parallel pattern depending on leaf type, creating a network of vascular tissue that distributes water and nutrients throughout the blade. Tertiary veins form finer branching patterns connecting the secondary veins and completing the venation network. The entire leaf structure demonstrates the vascular bundles containing xylem and phloem tissues that transport fluids and sugars. The leaf margins are clearly defined, showing whether they are smooth, serrated, or lobed. The presentation should be a clean cross-sectional and surface view botanical illustration in a scientific textbook style with no background clutter, suitable for educational purposes in plant biology or botany curricula.
